Description: As the system of record I need durable, migrated storage for all operational entities.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Core entities (incidents, evidence, agent runs, state transitions, actions, approvals, verifications, audit events, tool invocations, anomalies) survive an application restart.

- Requests have a timeout, bounded retries with jitter, and rate-limit handling (Retry-After honoured).
- Failures degrade to a typed integration error and are never reported as empty success.

Description: As a safety owner I need independent verification that distinguishes SUCCESS, FAILED and UNKNOWN.
Acceptance Criteria:

- Outcome is SUCCESS, FAILED or UNKNOWN, never inferred from an HTTP status code.
- UNKNOWN is used when data is insufficient, with the reason recorded.
- Verification result drives RESOLVED or ESCALATED.
Security: Verifier never reads the action result as evidence of effect; it re-queries the system of record.
Observability: verification_total by outcome, verification_latency_seconds.
Test Approach: tests/unit/verification — HTTP-200-but-no-effect case must return FAILED.
